change_summary: Populate the empty few_shot_examples.j2 with a compact verify→lookup→confirm-once→execute exemplar demonstrating terse one-pass confirmation.
reason_for_change: The few_shot file is empty and transcripts (tasks 91, 99) show repeated re-summarizing/re-confirming inflating the 27.3 mean turns. A concise exemplar modeling single-step identity verification, a single all-details confirmation, and immediate execution after 'yes' steers the agent toward fewer clarification/confirmation turns, reducing tokens/turns per task and thus mean cost while preserving the confirm-before-execute behavior needed for success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.051501 >= threshold 0.045669 (best mean 0.047950 - 1σ·0.002281)
hypothesis: Adding a compact worked example of the verify→lookup→confirm-once→execute flow steers the agent to fewer clarification/confirmation turns, cutting the 27.3 mean turns.
